screenshots.caption: The installed application filters the supplied clear maintenance event and displays its original detector and timestamp. The summary reports 71 events and 10 candidates with supplied-label precision 70 percent and recall 77.8 percent.
The installed application records a reasoned analyst disposition while retaining the original alert evidence. A review is a human assertion and does not rewrite detector accuracy.

observedTests.name: Release and runtime
observedTests.observed: All 5 downloaded assets matched provider/sidecar hashes. Actual frozen CPython 3.14.10 and Tcl/Tk 9.0.4 matched their recorded runtime identities.

observedTests.name: Real user workflow
observedTests.observed: Three exact saved bundles survived a second compiled launch. Real timeline/filter/review/export controls and malformed-input retention passed; all lifecycle buttons remained visible at 980 by 700 with a long status.

observedTests.name: Source and security
observedTests.observed: All current main workflows passed. Exact-source CodeQL analyses processed with zero open main alerts before publication.

observedTests.name: Desktop delivery
observedTests.observed: New individual Desktop and Start-menu links target the installed accepted EXE. Shortcut metadata was read back; normal shortcut activation was not independently exercised.
